title: Mirae Asset Securities and Grvt Collaborate on Tokenised Funding Note Issuance
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Singapore, Singapore, October 27th, 2026] The collaboration begins with Grvt’s subscription to Mirae Asset Securities’ tokenised funding notes, with potential future tokenised products (e.g., tokenised Treasuries, corporate bonds and ETFs) to be explored, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.
